    a = int(re.search(r"a = (\d+)", dat).group(1))
    b = int(re.search(r"b = (\d+)", dat).group(1))

    Py = int(re.search(r"P1 = \((\d+), (\d+)\)", dat).group(2))
    Qx = int(re.search(r"P2 = \((\d+), (\d+)\)", dat).group(1))
    Qy = int(re.search(r"P2 = \((\d+), (\d+)\)", dat).group(2))

    io.recvuntil(b"secret?")

    resp = io.recv().decode()

def write_sage_script(p, a, b, Px, Py, Qx, Qy):
    content = f"""
from sage.all import *
p = {p}
a = {a}
b = {b}
Px = {Px}
Py = {Py}
Qx = {Qx}
Qy = {Qy}
F = FiniteField(p)
